meta.scope: offline static; no module loaded, no radio contacted, no channel changed
meta.method: token census across two kernel modules and two daemon copies; scoring line extraction from ubntspecd; tone-geometry and channel-descriptor format extraction; explicit probe for the bps/Hz expression
premise_corrections: airMagic is a product name, not a kernel symbol: airmagic/airMagic return 0 in ubnt_poll_host.ko, and the mechanism lives in the ubntspecd daemon
the scoring is a three-tier BPS->SCORE->RATING output per channel per bandwidth, but the arithmetic between the tiers is not in the strings

gaps: airMagic is a product name: the kernel modules carry none of the airMagic vocabulary, so the scoring is not a kernel function
the three tiers BPS, SCORE and RATING are printed but the arithmetic between them is not: there is no efficiency, score = or bps/Hz expression anywhere
the interference histogram combination across associated CPEs was not located; the daemon receives a STA list and reports limits, but the aggregation code is not named
the 5 MHz portioning is implied by CHZ/CNTR/EDGE plus tones_per_chan, but no explicit 5 MHz constant exists in the daemon
the two capacity guards (AMG_MAX_CHANS, AMG_NUM_CONTROL) bound the candidate set without revealing how candidates are ranked
